subject: ACMECorp QBR — Executive sponsor alignment & scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecorp.com>, Priya Narang <priya.narang@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ACMECorp QBR — Executive sponsor alignment & scheduling

Hi Jordan / Priya,

Hope you’re both well. It’s time for our Q2 QBR and Marcus requested an executive-level alignment so we can review performance, upcoming roadmap, and the renewal/expansion plan. Proposed audience: Marcus Long (VP, Product), your GTM/engineering leads, CAM/procurement, + our AE/SE/CSM/solutions engineering folks.

Can you share availability the week of May 11 or May 18 for a 60–75 minute slot with Marcus? If Marcus prefers a shorter exec overview followed by a breakout with engineering, we can do a 30-minute exec + 45 breakout.

I've looped in Ethan (SE) and Dev (CSM) to surface technical highlights/questions in advance. Draft agenda attached — please review and flag anything missing.

Agenda (attached: ACME_QBR_agenda_v2.pdf)
- Exec summary & outcomes (10–15m)
- Usage/perf/cost highlights (15m)
- Roadmap and model/versioning discussion (15m)
- Security/compliance updates (10m)
- Breakout: deep-dive for eng + action items (30–45m)

Next steps: if you can send 2–3 preferred windows (with timezone), I’ll coordinate calendars.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

-----
Attachment: ACME_QBR_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Narang <priya.narang@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Cameron Lee <c.lee@acmecorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>

Marissa —

Thanks for the heads up and the agenda. Marcus is traveling the week of May 11 and prefers May 18 if possible. He’s available May 18 between 10:30–12:00 PT or 15:00–16:00 PT. Priya and I will confirm the rest of the team once we see options.

Also, can you include a short slide on retention and cost trends? Our procurement team (cc) will want to review consumption and forecast before renewal conversations. Cameron (CISO) asked to be included for the security/compliance update; he may only join the exec portion.

Jordan

jordan.smith@acmecorp.com

Subject: Re: ACMECorp QBR — Executive sponsor alignment & scheduling

Marissa / team —

Per Jordan, Marcus is available May 18 10:30–12:00 PT (prime). Please: 
- Marissa: propose two slots that include the 10:30–11:00 exec window + a breakout following.
- Ethan / Ben: prep 1–2 slides on performance, retention, and cost trends; Dev: prep the support/health items and any action items for the breakout.
- I'll review the agenda and add a slide on roadmap signals.

Let's try to avoid more than one follow-up reschedule — get calendar invites and a stub for Marcus's EA if we have one.

--Lauren
Lauren Bishop | Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Jordan / Priya —

Thanks. Proposing two options that preserve the exec + breakout structure so Marcus can join the first segment and leave after 30 minutes if needed: 

Option A: Mon, May 18 — 10:30–12:00 PT (30m exec: 10:30–11:00, 50m breakout + buffer)
Option B: Tue, May 19 — 09:00–10:15 PT (30m exec: 09:00–09:30, 45m breakout + buffer)

Attached updated agenda and a short capacity slides deck (capacity_report_may.pptx). Please confirm which option works and we’ll send calendar invites. If Marcus prefers a 30-minute exec only, say so and we’ll follow with a separate technical deep-dive.

I’ll include a DocuSign link for the renewal term sheet only after we align on dates — no action required now.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the options. Marcus can do Mon, May 18 at 10:30 PT — that works best for him. He’ll join the 10:30–11:00 exec portion and then – if needed – one of our engineering leads will stay for the breakout. Procurement would like the capacity deck in advance; can you confirm the top-line forecast slide will be included?

We do have one ask: Cameron will only join the exec portion (10:30–11:00). If we can keep the exec focused on outcomes and risks that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Priya

Perfect — thanks Priya. I’ve booked the calendar for Mon, May 18 10:30–12:00 PT with a 30-minute exec + breakout. Calendar invite sent to Marcus and the team; included the capacity slide in the packet and flagged the top-line forecast slide for procurement.

Action items (owner):
- Ethan / Ben: finalize perf & retention slides; include a short forecast slide for procurement — due Fri EOD PT.
- Dev: compile support/uptime highlights and any open tickets for the breakout.
- Lauren: I'll loop you into the invite with an owner tag for the exec intro.

I’ll also send a one-page executive brief (PDF) tomorrow morning for Marcus and Cameron. If anything changes, please let me know ASAP and I’ll work with Marcus’s EA.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to a productive QBR.

Marissa
